lines.en: - Look, I know you've been really depressed lately,
so I've brought someone over to cheer you up.
Right outside this store is a real live furry playmate.
- Oh, no, I'm not sleeping with your friend Jane again.
Ooh, you gotta admit, looks a lot like Jane.
This is the happiest dog in the world.
I borrowed him from my friend Wendy.
So you can keep him 'til he cheers you up,
and he will cheer you up.
We are gonna have so much fun, yes, we are.
